title: Original collages / City, neighbourhood and everyday life

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Show related scenes together so viewers can judge how one visual language accommodates different city experiences.
strategic_value: Repeated linework and a limited set of colors can make Helsinki’s different subjects feel like one family.
demonstration: Three portrait collages sit side by side on a pale-blue field, combining construction and water, neighbourhood life, and everyday activities.
practical_value: Compare density and subject variety across complete collages before extracting individual motifs.

content_islands.name: Three original compositions
content_islands.spec: Align the portrait sheets at equal height with consistent blue gutters.

reference_purposes.Expression: The three collages share outlined figures, architectural fragments and flat-color accents.
